items.headline: Flood Watch issued October 11 at 2:21AM EDT until October 11 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...A portion of eastern North Carolina, including the
following areas, Coastal Onslow, East Carteret, Hatteras Island,
Inland Onslow, Jones, Mainland Dare, Mainland Hyde, Northern Outer
Banks, Ocracoke Island, Pamlico, Southern Craven and West Carteret.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- A plume of tropical moisture will overspread the area and will
combine with strong lift and weak to moderate instability to
support areas of intense rainfall rates and an accompanying risk
of flooding. Additional rainfall totals of 1 to 3 inches are
forecast, with locally higher amounts possible. The highest
amounts are expected to be where bands of thunderstorms are most
persistent.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood
Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared
to take action should flooding develop.

items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 11 at 2:18AM EDT until October 11 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...The beaches from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...From 8 AM EDT this morning through this evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The most likely time for strong rip
currents to occur is a couple hours either side of low tide,
which will occur around 3 PM Sunday.
items.instruction:
Life-threatening rip currents. If caught in a rip current, remain
calm. Swim in a direction following the shoreline. If tired,
float or tread water until out of the rip current. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 11 at 8:30AM EDT until October 12 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
